preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of cities N must be between 2 and 5000.
The number of roads proposed by other companies M1 must be between 1 and 20000.
The number of roads proposed by Chef's company M2 must be between 1 and 20000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= 1000000000 for u, v, c in roads)
preconditions.description: The cost of each road must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len(stdout.split()) == 2 and int(stdout.split()[0]) >= 0 and int(stdout.split()[1]) >= 0)
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'Impossible', it must contain two non-negative integers representing the maximum profit and the minimum total cost.

postconditions.expression: any(u != v for u, v, c in roads)
postconditions.description: There must be at least one road connecting different cities.

postconditions.expression: all(c >= 0 for u, v, c in chef_roads)
postconditions.description: All roads proposed by Chef's company must have non-negative costs.
